title: How to remove a specific actor's shadow?

posts.author: LupineDev
posts.body:
I'm using RPG Maker MZ and I have access to Visustella's Events and Movement Core.
I need the shadow of my 9th Actor to disappear. Since they're a fire elemental and produce light, it doesn't make sense for them to cast a shadow.
Visustella's plugin seems to only remove shadows from events, not actors (please correct me if I'm wrong).
Any help would be appreciated.

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body: does the sprite sheet itself have a shadow? Because I think you should just be able to erase that and then there'd be no shadow normally

posts.author: LupineDev
posts.body: No, the spritesheet does not have a shadow. The shadow is added in via MZ. I don't want to erase the shadow in the system folder itself. I just want to get rid of a specific actor's shadow.

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: I think it can't be done sadly, you can define the file name or disable itfor event,s but not for the player in  Visustella's Events and Movement Core. Sadly. Considering the fact that their scripts are obfocused, it would probably be easiest to write them with an idea for such an update.

posts.author: Robro33
LupineDev
Robro33
posts.body:
LupineDev said:
What do you mean loading this after the VS plugin? Load what?
Click to expand...
take the code i posted, paste it into a text editor, save it as a .js file, and add it to your project as a plugin. as a plugin, it should be placed underneath the VS event and movement plugin.
LupineDev said:
And do I just stick that code in the actor's notebox as is? Or do I modify it?
Click to expand...
dont modify the code at all. the only thing youre doing to your actors is adding a <Hide Shadow> notetag to the ones that dont have shadows
